blocks.note: Choose the definite article for identifiable referents, general classes, names and conventional expressions where French and English differ.
Use French singular number when several people each possess one body part, item or personal attribute.
Distinguish bare de after an indefinite expression from fused de plus a definite plural article.
Control d'autres, des autres and formal written de before a prenominal adjective.
Select partitive forms for unbounded substances and abstract qualities in clean whole-sentence translations.
Transform affirmative clauses to negatives while preserving the être, single-one and contrast exceptions.
Retrieve article omission inside compounds and fixed noun constructions from clean translation items.
Integrate demonstrative and possessive determiners and their corresponding pronouns in discourse.
